svg.title: Synthetic instructions scale task diversity
svg.desc: FLAN creates many natural-language phrasings across tasks. Self-Instruct samples seed tasks, generates new instructions and instances, filters near-duplicates and adds survivors to a growing pool. Classification uses output-first generation to reduce label imbalance; LIMA emphasizes a small set of high-quality examples.

g.text: FLAN adds task/template variety; Self-Instruct grows a filtered seed pool.
SELF-INSTRUCT · GENERATE, FILTER, GROW THE POOL
For classification, choose an output label first to avoid popularity imbalance; LIMA instead stresses a small set of high-quality examples.
